scenes.title: A checkpoint is a decision
scenes.visual: Founder reviews anonymous four-module deliverable cards.
scenes.narration: You have reached the Discover checkpoint. Review what you learned, what remains unknown and what you can realistically do next. Choose go, refine or pause. This is a learning decision, not a success prediction, investment approval or automatic permission to launch.

scenes.title: Review the evidence and limits
scenes.visual: Editable supported, inferred, planned and unknown cards.
scenes.narration: Review your founder commitment, selected problem, customer research and opportunity brief. Preserve sources, contradictions and planned research. Completing twenty lessons does not turn assumptions into facts. If evidence is weak, say so and plan the next check rather than manufacturing certainty.

scenes.title: Understand go
scenes.visual: Editable next-test question and permission cards.
scenes.narration: Go means proceed to a bounded next round of testing, usually in Validate. It does not mean launch, proven demand or guaranteed funding. State the unresolved question, feasible test, permission needed and what would change your direction. Critical access or safety constraints still apply.

scenes.title: Understand refine and pause
scenes.visual: Editable refine and pause cards without success badges.
scenes.narration: Refine means narrow or change the group, problem, approach or research design before further testing. Pause means stop active work for now because evidence, access, resources or priority do not justify it. Neither is failure. Record the reason and the condition for revisiting.

scenes.title: Make the decision reviewable
scenes.visual: Founder records counterargument, owner and review date.
scenes.narration: Explain the evidence for your choice, the strongest reason against it, unresolved risks and critical constraints. Set the next action, owner, timing and effort limit. Define an observable review trigger. Do not let a high rating override missing permission or treat a polite preference as purchasing evidence.

scenes.title: Close Discover honestly
scenes.visual: Actual approved Lesson 20 worksheet and local completion state.
scenes.narration: Create your Discover Decision Record and review all four modules. Local phase completion requires all twenty lessons, but your decision can be go, refine or pause. Learning completion and venture validation are separate. The prototype records your plan locally; Phase 02 is a planned handoff, not a connected course or automatic submission.

sections.label: 02 / LEARN
sections.heading: Choose the next learning step, not a verdict on your worth.

children: Go
Proceed to a bounded next test. Demand, payment, permission and launch readiness remain separate questions.
Refine
Adjust or narrow your group, problem, approach or research design, then check the revised focus.
Pause
Stop active work for now; record why and what would justify revisiting. Pausing is a valid outcome.
Review trigger
An observable condition or date that prompts reconsideration. Avoid vague confidence as the only criterion.
Review four learning packs
Module 1.1: founder profile, responsibilities, purpose, skills/support and commitment.
Module 1.2: journal, affected people, problem map, alternatives and problem selection.
Module 1.3: customer snapshot, journey, source log, landscape and research plan.
Module 1.4: opportunity statement, value proposition, fit assessment, brief and this decision record.

Use the dashboard to review any lesson. Completion only checks field presence, acknowledgements and quiz answers. It does not review substantive evidence. Planned research remains planned; an incomplete evidence base can justify refine or pause, or a narrowly defined next test.
Review founder commitment
Review research plan
Review fit assessment
Review opportunity brief
Make the choice accountable

Explain supporting evidence, strongest counterargument, unresolved questions and constraints. Set owner, timing, effort limit, permission status and fallback. A go decision cannot override pending permission. Refine or pause never prevents local lesson completion.

Simulated Coach · no AI connection
Try four scripted guidance modes. The preview reads your current worksheet locally; it does not send information anywhere.

replies.teach: Go means further testing, refine means adjust the focus, and pause means revisit under stated conditions. All three are valid learning decisions.
replies.guide: Review four modules, preserve evidence/unknowns, explain your choice and counterargument, and set a bounded next action with constraints and review trigger.
replies.review: Checkpoint check: {missing} required fields still empty. This scripted check counts fields only; it cannot verify evidence, recommend a decision, grant permission or approve a venture.
replies.challenge: Are completed lessons being mistaken for validation? What contradicts the choice? Does the next action respect constraints? What would make you refine or pause?

More questions to discuss

Is the next action small and permitted? Does the current workaround suffice? Are sources traceable? Have you made space for contradictions? Is pause a reasonable resource decision? Who reviews the result?
Answer all three. You can retry; all three correct are required for local completion.
